name: Alaska Airlines Visa Signature® credit card

benefits.name: Annual Companion Fare
benefits.description: $99 companion fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) for a traveling companion on Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines flights, earned each account anniversary year after $6,000 in prior-year spend.
benefits.terms: Requires $6,000+ in purchases in the prior anniversary year. Valid on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines flights booked on alaskaair.com; not valid for award travel. This card has been rebranded by the issuer as the Atmos Rewards Ascent Visa Signature card; terms verified against the current product.

benefits.name: Free Checked Bag
benefits.description: First checked bag free for the cardholder and up to 6 companions on the same reservation when the ticket is purchased with the card.
benefits.terms: Applies on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines flights when airfare is purchased with the card.

benefits.name: Inflight Purchase Discount
benefits.description: 20% back on eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines inflight purchases, including food, beverages, and Wi-Fi, when paid with the card.

benefits.name: Alaska Lounge+ Membership Discount
benefits.description: $100 off an annual Alaska Lounge+ membership when paid with the card.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Discount only; membership must be purchased separately at a reduced rate.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per purchased ticket in reimbursement for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed 12+ hours.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $1,500 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Lost/Damaged Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per passenger for lost or damaged checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage — applies after the renter's personal auto insurance. Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year, up to $10,000 per item and $50,000 per calendar year.

earningRates.terms: Eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases.
